prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Actual isolated production preview sprite asset for AetherJump haunted tower. Image 1 is approved tower/prop identity and palette reference. Image 2 is RENDER STYLE ONLY, do not depict any hero, staff or character from it. Bold charcoal outline, flat matte colors, simple two-tone cel shadows, large readable forms at mobile game scale. Flat frontal orthographic 2D, not 3D/perspective. No text, titles, labels, arrows, layout frame, watermarks or prop studies. Create ONE square seamless wall texture module, fills the entire image with opaque masonry edge to edge. Muted plum/burgundy stone bricks, soft violet shallow vertical stone pilasters, horizontal shallow stone molding. Same haunted masonry as image 1 but NO lanterns, banners, windows, creatures, webs, mist or glow painted into the wall. Calm low-contrast background for gameplay overlay. Repeat left-to-right and top-to-bottom with matching edge patterns, no image border, no floor, no ceiling, no terminal side walls. Even flat illumination, no central vignette, no cast lighting or directional gradients. Bricks tile continuously; pilaster is centered with matching brick fields at both side edges. Horizontal molding crosses center with same endpoints at left and right. Output a square 1536x1536 or larger texture.
